tasks.title: ICE SHIELD LH/RH
tasks.summary: Allowable damage for LH/RH ice shield.
conditions: Maximum allowable damage depth on the ice shield: 8 mm (0.315 in.).
If damage depth is greater than 6 mm (0.236 in.), inspect the fuselage skin below the ice shield for possible impact signs.

tasks.title: FUSELAGE FWD SECTION STRUCTURE — ALLOWABLE DENTS IN SKIN PANELS
tasks.summary: Dent limits in FWD fuselage skin panels. Useful for fuselage skin around the cargo-compartment-door area after the correct structural area is identified.
conditions: A = distance between the dent and the closest stiffener edge line.
Allowable dent depth = A × 0.02, but cannot exceed 2.0 mm at any point of the skin panel.
This task is valid for D≥E. If D<E, inspect the stiffener and contact the manufacturer for further instructions.
If E cannot be identified, use minimum E = 13 mm as the reference measuring point for A.
Do not fill dents which exceed the allowable limits.
